chapterInfo.content:
15
Mose dwom
1 # Adi 15.3 Ɛnna Mose ne Israelfoɔ too dwom yi maa AWURADE kaa sɛ:
Mɛto AWURADE dwom, na ma na wama ne ho soɔ,
ɔpɔnkɔ ne ne sotefoɔ no, wato wɔn agu ɛpo mu.
2 # Dwom 118.14; Yes 12.2 M’ahoɔden ne me dwontoɔ ne AWURADE,
na wayɛ me nkwagyeɛ.
Ɔno ne me Nyankopɔn, na mɛkamfo no.
Ɔyɛ m’agya Nyankopɔn, na mɛma no so.
3 # Eks 14.14; Dwom 46.9; Eks 3.15 AWURADE yɛ dɔmmarima,
AWURADE ne ne din.
4Farao nteaseɛnam ne ne dɔm no, wato wɔn agu ɛpo mu,
na n’akofoɔ a wɔayi wɔn no, wɔamemmem Mmɛwa Po mu.
5Ebunu akata wɔn so,
wɔamem kɔ aseɛ tɔnn sɛ ɔboɔ.
6AWURADE, wode tumi ahyɛ wo nsa nifa animuonyam,
AWURADE, wo nsa nifa no dwɛre atamfoɔ no.
7 # Yes 47.14 Na wo tumi a ɛso no ara na wode butu wɔn a wɔsɔre tia woɔ no.
Wosoma w’abufuhyeɛ ba, ɛhye wɔn sɛ nkyɛnkyɛmma.
8Na wo hwene mu ahome mu na nsuo no ano boaeɛ;
asorɔkyeɛ gyinaa sɛ ekuo;
abunu kyekyeree ɛpo yam.
9Ɔtamfoɔ no kaa sɛ:
Mɛti wɔn, mɛto wɔn, mɛkyɛ asase no mu, wɔbɛmee me kra.
Mɛtwe me nkrantɛ, me nsa bɛsɛe wɔn.
10Wode wo mframa hui, ɛpo no kataa wɔn so;
wɔmemee sɛ sumpii wɔ nsu kɛseɛ no mu.
11 # Eks 18.11; Dwom 72.18-19 Hwan na ɔte sɛ woɔ, AWURADE, wɔ anyame mu?
Hwan na ɔte sɛ woɔ, kronkronyɛ mu onimuonyamfoɔ,
deɛ ne ho yɛ hu ayeyie mu, anwanwadeɛyɛfoɔ.
12Wotenee wo nifa,
asase menee wɔn.
13Wode w’adɔeɛ gyaa ɔman a woagye wɔn yi,
wode w’ahoɔden kyerɛɛ wɔn kwan kɔɔ wo kronkronyɛ tenabea.
14 # Yos 2.9-11 Aman tee, na wɔn ho wosoe,
ahopopoɔ kaa wɔn a wɔte Filistia.
15Ɛno na Edom asafohempanin ho dwirii wɔn,
Moab ahoɔdenfoɔ no, nketenkete kutaa wɔn,
Kanaanfoɔ nyinaa hodwoe.
16Ehu ne suro gu wɔn so,
wo basa kɛseyɛ nti wɔayeyɛ komm sɛ ɔboɔ,
kɔsi sɛ wo man bɛtwam, O AWURADE,
kɔsi sɛ ɔman a wogyee wɔn no bɛtwam.
17Wode wɔn bɛba, na woabɛtɛ wɔn w’agyapadeɛ bepɔ no so,
AWURADE, faako a wode hɔ ayɛ wo tenabea,
kronkronbea a, AWURADE, wo nsa asiesie no.
18 # Dwom 93.1 AWURADE bɛdi hene de bɛkɔ akɔsi daa daa.
Miriam dwom
19 # Eks 14.22-29 Na Farao apɔnkɔ ne ne nteaseɛnam ne n’apɔnkɔfoɔ baa ɛpo no mu, na AWURADE maa ɛpo no sane bɛkataa wɔn so, na Israelfoɔ no nam asase pɛsɛɛ so faa ɛpo no mfimfini. 20#Dwom 68.25 Na odiyifoɔ baa Miriam a ɔyɛ Aaron nua no faa akasae kurae, na mmaa no nyinaa de akasae ne asa firi dii n’akyi. 21#Eks 15.1 Na Miriam gyee wɔn so sɛ:
Monto AWURADE dwom, na wadi nkonim animuonyam mu;
ɔpɔnkɔ ne ne sotefoɔ no, wato wɔn agu ɛpo mu.
Mara nsuo a ɛyɛ nwono
22Ɛnna Mose maa Israel tu firii Mmɛwa Po ho, na wɔfiri hɔ kɔɔ Sur serɛ so; na wɔnantee ɛserɛ no so nnansa, na wɔnnya nsuo.
23Na wɔduruu Mara no, na wɔntumi nnom Mara nsuo, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ nwono. Enti wɔtoo hɔ din Mara.#15.23 MARA: Asekyerɛ ne: Nwononwono. 24Na ɔman no kasaa huhuhuhu tiaa Mose sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na yɛnnom?
25Na ɔsu frɛɛ AWURADE, na AWURADE kyerɛɛ no dua bi, na ɔde too nsuo no mu, na nsuo no yɛɛ dɛ. Ɛhɔ na ɔhyɛɛ ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmuo maa wɔn, na ɛhɔ nso na ɔsɔɔ wɔn hwɛeɛ, 26#Deut 7.15; 32.39; Mat 9.12 na Mose kaa sɛ: Sɛ wobɛtie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne, na woayɛ deɛ ɛtene wɔ n’anim, na woatie ne mmara nsɛm, na woadi n’ahyɛdeɛ nyinaa so a, ɛnneɛ meremfa yadeɛ a mede meguu Misraim soɔ no biara mengu wo so; na mene AWURADE, wo yaresafoɔ no.
27Na wɔduruu Elim a nsubura dummienu ne akyiresua aduɔson wɔ no. Na wɔkyeree nsraban wɔ nsuo no ho hɔ.

pageProps.chapterText:
Ɛnna Mose ne Israelfoɔ too dwom yi maa AWURADE kaa sɛ:
Mɛto AWURADE dwom, na ma na wama ne ho soɔ,
ɔpɔnkɔ ne ne sotefoɔ no, wato wɔn agu ɛpo mu.
M’ahoɔden ne me dwontoɔ ne AWURADE,
na wayɛ me nkwagyeɛ.
Ɔno ne me Nyankopɔn, na mɛkamfo no.
Ɔyɛ m’agya Nyankopɔn, na mɛma no so.
AWURADE yɛ dɔmmarima,
AWURADE ne ne din.

Farao nteaseɛnam ne ne dɔm no, wato wɔn agu ɛpo mu,
na n’akofoɔ a wɔayi wɔn no, wɔamemmem Mmɛwa Po mu.
Ebunu akata wɔn so,
wɔamem kɔ aseɛ tɔnn sɛ ɔboɔ.
AWURADE, wode tumi ahyɛ wo nsa nifa animuonyam,
AWURADE, wo nsa nifa no dwɛre atamfoɔ no.
Na wo tumi a ɛso no ara na wode butu wɔn a wɔsɔre tia woɔ no.
Wosoma w’abufuhyeɛ ba, ɛhye wɔn sɛ nkyɛnkyɛmma.
Na wo hwene mu ahome mu na nsuo no ano boaeɛ;
asorɔkyeɛ gyinaa sɛ ekuo;
abunu kyekyeree ɛpo yam.
Ɔtamfoɔ no kaa sɛ:
Mɛti wɔn, mɛto wɔn, mɛkyɛ asase no mu, wɔbɛmee me kra.
Mɛtwe me nkrantɛ, me nsa bɛsɛe wɔn.
Wode wo mframa hui, ɛpo no kataa wɔn so;
wɔmemee sɛ sumpii wɔ nsu kɛseɛ no mu.
Hwan na ɔte sɛ woɔ, AWURADE, wɔ anyame mu?
Hwan na ɔte sɛ woɔ, kronkronyɛ mu onimuonyamfoɔ,
deɛ ne ho yɛ hu ayeyie mu, anwanwadeɛyɛfoɔ.
Wotenee wo nifa,
asase menee wɔn.

Wode w’adɔeɛ gyaa ɔman a woagye wɔn yi,
wode w’ahoɔden kyerɛɛ wɔn kwan kɔɔ wo kronkronyɛ tenabea.
Aman tee, na wɔn ho wosoe,
ahopopoɔ kaa wɔn a wɔte Filistia.
Ɛno na Edom asafohempanin ho dwirii wɔn,
Moab ahoɔdenfoɔ no, nketenkete kutaa wɔn,
Kanaanfoɔ nyinaa hodwoe.
Ehu ne suro gu wɔn so,
wo basa kɛseyɛ nti wɔayeyɛ komm sɛ ɔboɔ,
kɔsi sɛ wo man bɛtwam, O AWURADE,
kɔsi sɛ ɔman a wogyee wɔn no bɛtwam.
Wode wɔn bɛba, na woabɛtɛ wɔn w’agyapadeɛ bepɔ no so,
AWURADE, faako a wode hɔ ayɛ wo tenabea,
kronkronbea a, AWURADE, wo nsa asiesie no.
AWURADE bɛdi hene de bɛkɔ akɔsi daa daa.

Na Farao apɔnkɔ ne ne nteaseɛnam ne n’apɔnkɔfoɔ baa ɛpo no mu, na AWURADE maa ɛpo no sane bɛkataa wɔn so, na Israelfoɔ no nam asase pɛsɛɛ so faa ɛpo no mfimfini. Na odiyifoɔ baa Miriam a ɔyɛ Aaron nua no faa akasae kurae, na mmaa no nyinaa de akasae ne asa firi dii n’akyi. Na Miriam gyee wɔn so sɛ:
Monto AWURADE dwom, na wadi nkonim animuonyam mu;
ɔpɔnkɔ ne ne sotefoɔ no, wato wɔn agu ɛpo mu.

Ɛnna Mose maa Israel tu firii Mmɛwa Po ho, na wɔfiri hɔ kɔɔ Sur serɛ so; na wɔnantee ɛserɛ no so nnansa, na wɔnnya nsuo.
Na wɔduruu Mara no, na wɔntumi nnom Mara nsuo, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ nwono. Enti wɔtoo hɔ din Mara. Na ɔman no kasaa huhuhuhu tiaa Mose sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na yɛnnom?
Na ɔsu frɛɛ AWURADE, na AWURADE kyerɛɛ no dua bi, na ɔde too nsuo no mu, na nsuo no yɛɛ dɛ. Ɛhɔ na ɔhyɛɛ ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmuo maa wɔn, na ɛhɔ nso na ɔsɔɔ wɔn hwɛeɛ, na Mose kaa sɛ: Sɛ wobɛtie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne, na woayɛ deɛ ɛtene wɔ n’anim, na woatie ne mmara nsɛm, na woadi n’ahyɛdeɛ nyinaa so a, ɛnneɛ meremfa yadeɛ a mede meguu Misraim soɔ no biara mengu wo so; na mene AWURADE, wo yaresafoɔ no.
Na wɔduruu Elim a nsubura dummienu ne akyiresua aduɔson wɔ no. Na wɔkyeree nsraban wɔ nsuo no ho hɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
